question: Where can I find a hotel that sit within 150 kilometers on the south side of School of Cosmetology, Somerset, KY?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%School of Cosmetology%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Somerset%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 150000) AND ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)) < ST_Y(ST_Centroid(( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%School of Cosmetology%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Somerset%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 ))) ORDER BY ST_Distance(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%School of Cosmetology%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Somerset%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 )::geography) ASC;
